info.text:
In 2025, gold hit 53 record highs. Fear helped drive it.
Gold's yearly average rose 44% to $3,431/oz in 2025; in 2008 it rose about 25% ($695 to $872).
Why: it's a safe haven nobody can default on, falling rates shrink the interest you give up, and it's priced in dollars (the dollar index fell 9.4% in 2025).
Central banks bought 863 tonnes of gold in 2025.
Sources: World Gold Council Gold Demand Trends FY2025; LBMA yearly averages; Bloomberg/NPR on the dollar index.
News and education, not financial advice.
